name: lookup_user
description: Find the calling employee in the company directory. Send either the employee number, or the first name plus surnames. Returns an internal user_id, the last two digits of the phone on file, and the account status.

employee_number.description: Employee number: two letters and four digits, letters uppercase, no spaces, e.g. 'BX4821'. Leave empty if searching by name.

first_name.description: The caller's full first name, including compound names ('María José', 'Juan Carlos'), with accents as normally written.

first_surname.description: First surname (apellido paterno), with accents, e.g. 'Hernández'. Compound surnames stay whole, e.g. 'Díaz de León'.

second_surname.description: Second surname (apellido materno), with accents, e.g. 'Villaseñor'. Leave empty if the caller has not given it or has only one surname.
